subject: collars dead in one go
body: Hi, about {n} of the collars on {farm} just stopped this morning, all at once. Theyre still on the cows, I checked a few. The ones up the other end are fine. What's going on?

subject: No locations since the weather
body: This is {first} from {farm}, writing from my home email. After all that rain the map hasn't moved for most of the herd near the {tower}. Is it your end or ours?

subject: {collar} flat every morning
body: Collar {collar} is flat most mornings, comes right by lunchtime then dies again overnight. Rest of the mob is fine. Bad battery?

subject: one collar not lasting
body: Got one that won't last the night anymore, number {num}. Sunny week too so it's not the weather.

subject: batteries dropping since update?
body: Since the app said the collars updated a couple of days ago the batteries on a lot of them are going down way quicker and half the time the cows don't show where they are. {collar} and {collar2} are two of them. Did the update break something?

subject: gaps in tracks
body: Lots of gaps in the tracks this week across the whole herd and the battery numbers are lower than they used to be. Nothing has changed on the farm.

subject: collar died
body: {collar} played up for a day, the app showed it really hot which was weird because it was a cold day, then it stopped altogether. Cow is fine.

subject: cow on the road??
body: App keeps putting cow {num} out on the road and then back in the paddock. She hasn't gone anywhere, I was looking at her. Collar playing up?

subject: back block collars in and out
body: The collars on the back hill block keep dropping in and out, they come back later in the day but it's annoying. {collar} is one. Are they faulty?

subject: low battery on everything
body: Every collar on {farm} is showing lower battery than normal after this run of rubbish weather. They're all still reporting. Should I be worried?

subject: found a collar in the grass
body: Found {collar} lying in the paddock this morning, strap looks stretched but the collar itself looks ok. How tight should these go back on?

subject: new worker can't see the cows
body: We've got a new farm hand starting Monday, how do I get him into the app so he can see the herd?

subject: charged twice
body: Looks like I've been charged twice for July. Can someone sort it out and put it back on my card.

subject: moving the heifers
body: Moving the heifers to the run-off next week, it's just over the road. Do I need to do anything with the collars or towers?

subject: too many texts
body: I'm getting texts all day about batteries. Can I just get one a day? And can my manager get them too.
